description: Shared vCard (.vcf) contract between the Normal parser (api-server/batch-parsing/file_parser.py) and the Demo parser (front-cards/features/demo/demoSpreadsheetParser.ts). Duplicated into both fixture dirs per repo convention (containers mount only their own subtree). Synthetic data only. Expected fields use canonical snake_case ids and are asserted AFTER the full mapping pipeline on each side (demo test converts snake->camel). unmappedContains are substrings of the consolidated 'vcf_unmapped' extra value.
